concerns.text: Task T019 executes data collection with `$TOP_PACKAGES` but does not define the value or source. Spec FR-001 and Plan.md defer this count to the research phase. Executing a task with an undefined variable violates FR-001's requirement to retrieve 'top [deferred] packages' and creates a non-deterministic execution path, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility).

Task T008 (Caching) is marked incomplete but is a prerequisite for T019 (Data Collection) and Constitution Principle VI (API Snapshot Integrity). The task list includes execution tasks (T019, T020) that depend on this missing artifact, creating a logical impossibility where the pipeline cannot satisfy FR-007 (real-call testing with snapshots) or Constitution Principle VI.

Tasks T023 (Power Analysis) and T024 (Execution) are marked incomplete. Spec SC-006 mandates measuring statistical power against a target of ≥ 0.8. Without these tasks, the project cannot verify the sample size sufficiency required by the spec, violating SC-006 and the Assumptions section regarding 'Multiplicity & power'.

Task T027 (Execute Core Correlation) and T030 (Significance Flagging) are incomplete. Spec FR-006 requires computing Spearman correlation and SC-001 requires measuring against the null hypothesis. Without these tasks, the core research question (US-2) cannot be answered, violating FR-006 and SC-001.

Tasks T034-T038 (Stratified Analysis) are incomplete. Spec FR-007 and SC-003 require stratified analysis by category and variance measurement. The absence of these tasks means the project cannot fulfill the requirements for US-3, violating FR-007 and SC-003.

Tasks T001 (Project Structure) and T003 (Linting) are marked incomplete. The Plan.md and Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) require a specific project structure and reproducible environment. Missing foundational setup tasks prevents the execution of all subsequent user stories, violating the structural constraints of the Plan.
